Review source-derived retrieval questions. Return JSON {"reviews":[{"id":same id,"supported":true/false,"reason":"brief"}]} in input order.
For each item verify that the supplied evidence excerpt contains the concrete information asked in both the
English and Chinese question. A general topic relationship is insufficient. Both questions must ask the same
detail. Mark unsupported if a question asks more than the quoted evidence supplies. Use only supplied text.

[{"id": "single-110", "evidence": "For example, Lassa fever is limited to rural areas of West Africa where rats and mice carry the virus.", "en": "I'm planning a trip to rural West Africa; which specific animals carry the Lassa fever virus in that region?", "zh": "我计划去西非农村地区旅行，那里的拉沙热病毒是由哪些特定动物携带的？"}, {"id": "single-111", "evidence": "It can be done with shock waves; with a scope inserted through the tube that carries urine out of the body, called the urethra; or with surgery.", "en": "If my kidney stone gets stuck and causes severe pain, what are some treatment options besides surgery?", "zh": "如果我的肾结石卡住并引起剧烈疼痛，除了手术之外还有哪些治疗方法？"}, {"id": "single-112", "evidence": "If your or your partner is allergic to latex , you can use polyurethane condoms.", "en": "My partner and I are allergic to latex; is there an alternative type of condom we can use to reduce the risk of gonorrhea?", "zh": "我和伴侣都对乳胶过敏；有没有其他类型的避孕套可以降低感染淋病的风险？"}, {"id": "single-113", "evidence": "People with cuts or open sores can get it if they touch the bacteria.", "en": "How can people get anthrax through their skin if they have open wounds?", "zh": "如果皮肤上有开放性伤口，人们是如何通过接触感染炭疽的？"}, {"id": "single-114", "evidence": "Specific types include: Black lung disease among coal miners, from inhaling coal dust Farmer's lung, from inhaling farm dust Asbestosis, from inhaling asbestos fibers Siderosis, from inhaling iron from mines or welding fumes Silicosis, from inhaling silica dust Other causes include autoimmune diseases or occupational exposures to molds, gases, or fumes.", "en": "What specific lung condition do coal miners develop from breathing in coal dust?", "zh": "煤矿工人吸入煤尘后会患上哪种特定的肺部疾病？"}, {"id": "single-115", "evidence": "Slouching or slumping over can: Misalign your musculoskeletal system Wear away at your spine, making it more fragile and prone to injury Cause neck, shoulder, and back pain Decrease your flexibility Affect how well your joints move Affect your balance and increase your risk of falling Make it harder to digest your food Make it harder to breathe How can I improve my posture in general?", "en": "What are some specific health problems that poor posture, like slouching, can cause?", "zh": "不良姿势（如驼背）会导致哪些具体的健康问题？"}, {"id": "single-116", "evidence": "Naltrexone blocks the receptors in your brain that make you feel good when you drink alcohol.", "en": "How does the medication Naltrexone help someone with alcohol use disorder?", "zh": "纳曲酮（Naltrexone）这种药物如何帮助酒精使用障碍患者？"}, {"id": "single-117", "evidence": "Causes of sciatica include: A ruptured intervertebral disk Narrowing of the spinal canal that puts pressure on the nerve, called spinal stenosis An injury such as a pelvic fracture.", "en": "What are some common causes of sciatica pain?", "zh": "坐骨神经痛的一些常见原因是什么？"}, {"id": "single-118", "evidence": "Even so, they can be dangerous if they press on vital organs, such as your brain.", "en": "Why can benign tumors be dangerous even though they do not spread to other parts of the body?", "zh": "为什么良性肿瘤即使不扩散到身体其他部位也可能是危险的？"}, {"id": "single-119", "evidence": "Examples of CAM therapies include acupuncture , chiropractic , and herbal medicines .", "en": "What are some examples of complementary and alternative medicine (CAM) therapies for cancer?", "zh": "癌症的补充和替代医学（CAM）疗法有哪些例子？"}]
